scope.limits: Only12owned engines/60 authored copies. No claim for othercatalog pages; no shared/generated/snapshot/sourcepriority edit, build, deployment oraccount actions.

baseline.provenance: 24 RU/EN copies owned full body;36 UK/DE/ES copies were metadata only, effective body came from actual legacy locale output. All60 effective bodies read before editing;36 useful inherited bodies materialized into current owned copies.

contracts.domain: n 1..1000, k 0..n, both exact safe integer lexemes; p finite 0..1; exactly/atMost/atLeast.
contracts.methodAndSubjectDecision: Independent equal-p Bernoulli trials; exact BigInt combination count, bounded log-sum-exp approximate probabilities. p=0/1 true zeros; positive selected probability outside binary64 fails. Correct factorial precision myth and distinguish event exactly k from numerical exactness.

contracts.domain: Finite mean, sd>=0, exact safe integer n>=2, confidence90/95/99; preserved Z1.645/1.96/2.576.
contracts.methodAndSubjectDecision: Normal known-sigma mean interval. If sample s is used, normal approximation; Student t not implemented. Repeated-sampling coverage, not probability of fixed population mean in an observed interval. Same data units. sd0 formal point; nonzero unrepresentable/collapsed width error, fine representable bounds show17significantdigits when needed.

contracts.domain: 3..10000 positional pairs, matching length, finite full tokens, no constant series, <=1000000characters per series.
contracts.methodAndSubjectDecision: Pearson/OLS with intercept; r dimensionless, sample covariance X*Y, slopeY/X, interceptY. Exact centered binary sums preserve huge/tiny recoverable results. No significance/p-value/causation claim. Units consistent within each series, X andY may differ.

contracts.domain: Exact integers count1..10, sides2..100, feasible integer target.
contracts.methodAndSubjectDecision: Fair independent identical dice, faces1..sides. Exact bounded BigInt inclusion-exclusion counts; total100^10 not rounded. Tiny nonzero probability shown scientifically. Correct10d20 safe-count claim to10d100=10^20.

contracts.domain: Four whitelist modes; exact nonnegative safe integer favourable<=positive total; independent probabilitiesfinite0..1, inactive inputs ignored.
contracts.methodAndSubjectDecision: Counts require equiprobability; independent intersection/union differs from disjoint union. Exact dyadic expression avoids cancellation in complement andtiny union; nonzero primary underflow error; auxiliary impossible odds explicit range diagnostic.

contracts.domain: 4..10000 finite tokens <=1000000characters; strict full-token grammar; min4 a product rule.
contracts.methodAndSubjectDecision: Type7 h=(n-1)p linear interpolation; other definitions valid. IQR and1.5IQR fences, observed whiskers are different; flag notprooferror. Exact binary interpolation/fence comparisons; primary nonzero unrepresentable median error, auxiliary range diagnostic.

contracts.domain: toRoman integer1..3999; toArabic trimmed/case-normalized canonical string <=15symbols; unknown modes reject.
contracts.methodAndSubjectDecision: Chosen modern subtractive canonical convention, notuniversal historical bound. Canonical comparison rejects IIII aliases butnotbecause historical representations wereambiguous. No decorative external source.

contracts.domain: Finite normalized binary64value, exact integer digits0..10; half/down/up.
contracts.methodAndSubjectDecision: Shortest decimal representation of input normalized to binary64, then exact BigInt decimal quantization. half ties away from zero, down floor, up ceiling. Preserve visible up-to10 decimal digits/original/signed difference; not arbitrary precision raw decimal or universal legalfinancialrule.

contracts.domain: confidence90/95/99 preserved full Z; positivefinite marginpercent, proportion0..100percent, population0unknown ornonnegative safe integer.
contracts.methodAndSubjectDecision: Normal planning of oneproportion under simple random sampling/response assumptions. Exactdyadic percentformula, exactceilBigInt andFPC; p50conservative under model, p0/100formalzero notsurveyrecommendation. Unknown fraction—. Defaultraw384.145882..=>385,N500corrected217.487218..=>218; doesnotestimateABpower.

contracts.domain: 1..10000 finite tokens <=1000000characters, sample/population modes, strict fulltoken grammar.
contracts.methodAndSubjectDecision: Mean/median/mode/range; exact centered sums, sample denominator n-1 vs population n. Singletons sample variance—, allunique mode— explicitreportconvention. SD data unit, variance squared; overflow/underflow diagnostics do not fakezero; skewness notproven by meanmedian difference.

contracts.domain: 1..10000 lines ofexactly2 finite tokens, <=1000000characters; weights>=0 andpositive total.
contracts.methodAndSubjectDecision: Weighted sum/product ratio exactly from finite binaryinputs; individual zero weights valid, negative rejected. Values share consistent units, weights owncommon scale cancels. Two-column textarea not falsely labeled asone scalar dataunit; auxiliary sums outside range explicit.

Exact binary difference thenratio, recoverable large signed differences valid. Same dataunits, dimensionlessz. Arithmetic doesnotrequire Gaussian data; Gaussian percentage interpretation does; no p-value/tail computation.

numericModel.inputs: Finite binary64 normalized values, strict original integral lexemes for integer fields; bool/blank/malformed/nonfinite/nonzero-underflow rejected. Not arbitraryprecision raw decimal.
numericModel.exactOperations: Private helper uses existing frozen exactdyadic pure module for finitebinary64 sums/products/ratios; private sqrtRatio rounds once to finalnormal/subnormal grid. BigInt counts, combinationcounts, decimalround quantization, sampleceil.
numericModel.approximations: Log binomial probability approximate; rounded CI Z constants preserved. Publication rounding remains existing ordinaryformat except scientificsmall/large values and CI17sig fallbackdistinctbounds.
numericModel.displayFailure: Primary nonzero underflow/unrepresentable result fails closed; finite primary mayretain auxiliary explicit above/below numeric range diagnostics instead ofInfinity/falsezero.

exampleAmendments.before: Al 95 % con un margen del 5 % hacen falta 385 personas, sea cual sea el tamaño de la ciudad.
